question:
Select the combination of numbers, from the given options, that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

3, 2, 13 / 5, 4, 41 /_, _, _.
solution:
Given: 3, 2, 13 / 5, 4, 41 /_, _, _.

The logic followed here is: 

**First number² + second number² = third number**

**First number - 1 = Second number**

3, 2, 13 → 3² = 9, 2² = 4 → 9 + 4 = 13 and 3 - 1 = 2

5, 4, 41 → 5² = 25, 4² = 16 → 25 + 16 = 41 and 5 - 1 = 4

Similarly, by checking options:

**(1) 7, 6, 85 → 7² = 49, 6² = 36 → 49 + 36 = 85 and 7 - 1 = 6 ** [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/2705/72.png] 

(2) 8, 7, 105 → 8² = 64, 7² = 49 → 64 + 49 = 113 ≠ 105 [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] 

(3) 6, 7, 85 → 6² = 36, 7² = 49 → 36 + 49 = 85 but 6 - 1 = 5 ≠ 7 [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] 

(4) 7, 8, 105 → 7² = 49, 8² = 64 → 49 + 64 = 113 ≠ 105 [IMAGE: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/14.0/274c/72.png] 

Hence, **"7, 6, 85" **is the correct answer.
